_comment: How the simulation's campus is derived from the real Oxford map and data/timeline.json (Phase 1, checkpoint 1a). Every number is a [TWEAK] starting guess.

kind_map._comment: timeline.json kind -> sim destination kind. Kinds not listed (admin, athletics, house, landmark, utility, other) aren't destinations yet; they still block walking.

housing._comment: Off-campus housing: the town's other buildings grouped into zones of zone_size_tiles x zone_size_tiles, each one sim destination weighted by its building tiles. Zones with fewer than min_building_tiles are dropped.
